title: PopMelodyGen: A Copyright-Aware Platform for Controllable Pop-Melody Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale redistributable symbolic pop-melody data remain scarce due to copyright restrictions, creating a bottleneck for both practical deployment and reproducible research in music generation. We present PopMelodyGen, a copyright-aware platform for controllable pop-melody generation that combines rule-based synthesis with neural generation. Our approach first uses an expert synthesizer to produce large-scale labeled synthetic melodies from explicit musical knowledge and templates, providing scalable pretraining data with auditable provenance. A neural model is then pretrained on this corpus and adapted with a small licensed real-pop corpus to improve melodic naturalness while preserving controllability. The platform supports interactive melody creation with accompaniment playback and export for creators, as well as batch construction of annotated symbolic datasets for researchers. translated_title: PopMelodyGen：一个版权感知的可控流行旋律生成平台
translated_abstract: 由于版权限制，大规模可再分发的符号化流行旋律数据仍然稀缺，这为音乐生成的实际部署和可复现研究造成了瓶颈。我们提出了PopMelodyGen，一个结合基于规则合成与神经生成的版权感知可控流行旋律生成平台。我们的方法首先使用专家合成器从显式音乐知识和模板生成大规模带标签的合成旋律，提供具有可审计来源的可扩展预训练数据。随后，神经模型在该合成语料库上进行预训练，并使用小型授权的真实流行音乐语料库进行适配，以在保持可控性的同时提升旋律的自然度。该平台为创作者提供支持伴奏播放和导出的交互式旋律创作功能，也为研究者提供带注释符号数据集的批量构建能力。PopMelodyGen展示了一种实用的训练和……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出版权感知的可控流行旋律生成平台PopMelodyGen，通过专家合成器生成可审计的大规模合成预训练数据，再结合小型授权真实流行音乐语料适配神经模型，同时服务于创作者的交互式旋律创作与研究者的带注释数据集构建。
